# BitDegree

> > BitDegree is a gamified Web3 learning platform where users earn crypto rewards through play-to-earn missions while learning blockchain and cryptocurrency skills.

BitDegree combines blockchain education with tokenized incentives, offering a mobile app, live crypto price tracking, and integration with Web3 tools. The platform leverages the BITS token reward system and supports global financial services through partner integrations like Ogvio for instant money transfers.

## Key Topics

- Web3 learning
- Play-to-earn
- Crypto rewards
- BITS token
- Blockchain education
- Bitcoin
- Ethereum
- Hardware wallets
- Gamified platform
- International money transfer
- Crypto portfolio tracking
- DeFi
- Instant payments
- AES encryption
- Solana

## Core Platform & Learning

- [Learn & Earn: Play to Earn Crypto Rewards and Learn Web3!](https://www.bitdegree.org): BitDegree platform: gamified Web3 learning with play-to-earn crypto rewards
- [BitDegree Crypto Earning App: Play to Earn Rewards](https://www.bitdegree.org/crypto/app/get): BitDegree mobile app for earning BITS tokens through Web3 missions

## Crypto Markets & Price Tracking

- [Track Cryptocurrency Prices Live & Get Crypto Market Analysis](https://www.bitdegree.org/cryptocurrency-prices): Live crypto price tracker for Bitcoin, Ethereum with real-time market analysis

## Global Payments & Money Transfer

- [Send Money Worldwide With No Hidden Fees, Instantly](https://www.bitdegree.org/crypto/goon/ogvio): Ogvio instant global money transfer with EUR/USD pegging & AES encryption

## Crypto Wallets & Security

- [Ledger - certified secure crypto Hardware Wallets | Ledger](https://www.bitdegree.org/crypto/goon/ledger): Ledger hardware wallets for secure BTC, ETH, XRP storage & custody
- [KeepKey](https://www.bitdegree.org/crypto/goon/keepkey): KeepKey hardware wallet for secure Bitcoin & cryptocurrency offline storage

## Portfolio Management & DeFi Tools

- [The Ultimate Crypto Portfolio Tracker | CoinStats](https://www.bitdegree.org/crypto/goon/coinstats): CoinStats portfolio tracker integrating wallets, exchanges & DeFi assets

## Optional Resources

- [BlastUp – Crecimiento y visibilidad en redes sociales para marcas](https://www.bitdegree.org/crypto/goon/blastup): BlastUp IDO launchpad on Blast ecosystem for DeFi & gaming projects
